MEMORANDUM

  Agenda Item #: __8___
  Meeting Date: July 24, 2018

TO:  HONORABLE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL

THRU:  ANTON DAHLERBRUCH, CITY MANAGER /s/

FROM:  KEN RUKAVINA, DIRECTOR OF COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT &
  PUBLIC WORKS / CITY ENGINEER /s/

SUBJECT: CONSIDERATION OF PARKLANDS COMMITTEE RECOMMENDATIONS
  OF JULY 12, 2018

DATE:  JULY 24, 2018

ISSUE/PURPOSE

The purpose of this memorandum is to transmit Parklands Committee recommendations from the
July 12, 2018 meeting to the City Council.

BACKGROUND/DISCUSSION

At its meeting of July 12, 2018 the Parklands Committee reviewed and discussed 7 applications for
tree removals as follows:

a. PC-506-18; Application to remove 1 Canary Island Date palm tree located in the parkway
  adjacent to 868 Via Del Monte

  Applicant:  Jerry Donahue
  864 Rincon Lane
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

The applicant, Jerry Donahue and the resident of 881 Via Del Monte, Bert Centofante spoke in
support of this view application.

  Page 1 of 4

  001
 Action: Committee member Leach motioned second by Kaviani to recommend to the City Council
approval to remove 1 Canary Island palm tree located in the parkway adjacent to 868 Via Del Monte
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. Require a $500 payment to the
‘Tree Bank’. The vote was (5-0, in favor).

b. PC-507-18; Application to remove 2 Red Iron Bark Eucalyptus trees located in the parkway
  adjacent to 736 and 741 Cloyden Road

  Applicant:  Irv Miller
  745 Cloyden Road
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

The applicant, Irv Miller indicated the view obstruction had been eliminated by the trimming done
by the City and no longer wanted to remove the trees. He was uncertain of the future maintenance of
the trees and advocated for change with no fee permits and reduced costs for trimming through the
use of the municipal contract.

Action: This application was withdrawn by the applicant. At this time Committee member Wade
motioned second by McCabe to direct staff to add an item to the next agenda to address tree trimming
costs and permit fees. The vote was (5-0, in favor).

c. PC-509-18; Application to remove 1 Coral tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1312 Via
Margarita

  Applicant:  Dirk J. Gaudet
  1312 Via Margarita
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

There were no speakers on this item.

Action: Committee member Richie-Bray motioned second by Leach to recommend to the City
Council approval to remove 1 Coral tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1312 Via Margarita
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. Require a $500 payment to the
‘Tree Bank’ and removal of the stump. The vote was (5-0, in favor).

d. PC-510-18; Application to remove 3 Canary Island pine trees located in the parkway adjacent to
2917 Via Rivera

  Applicant:  Ed and Terry Poplawski
  3000 Via Victoria
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

The applicants, Ed and Terry Poplawski, their nextdoor neighbors Steve and Megan Ebenhack,
Dianne Shneer of 849 Rivera Place and Jeanette Peter, the resident adjacent to the trees spoke in
support of this view application. No one spoke in opposition.

  Page 2 of 4

  002
 Action: Committee member Leach motioned second by Kaviani to recommend to the City Council
approval to remove 3 Canary Island pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2917 Via Rivera
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. Payment of $1,500 to the Tree
Bank and removal of the stumps are required. The vote was (5-0, in favor).

e. PC-511-18; Application to remove 2 Eucalyptus trees located in the parkway adjacent to 2765
  Via Campesina

  Applicant:  Sunil Adwani
  2765 Via Campesina
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

The applicant, Sunil Adwani spoke in support of this safety application.

Action: Committee member Leach motioned second by Richie-Bray to recommend to the City
Council approval to remove 2 Eucalyptus trees located in the parkway adjacent to 2765 Via
Campesina according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal approvals’. Payment of $1,000
to the ‘Tree Bank’ and removal of the stumps are required. The vote was (4-0-1 in favor, Kaviani
recused).

f. PC-512-18; Application to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the Parklands adjacent to 915
  Via Panorama

  Applicant:  Karen Miller
  924 Via Panorama
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

The applicant, Karen Miller and the resident of 916 Via Panorama spoke in support of this view
application.

Action: Committee member Kaviani motioned second by Leach to recommend to the City Council
approval to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the Parklands adjacent to 915 Via Panorama
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. Require $500 payment to the
‘Tree Bank’ and removal of the stump. The vote was (4-1, in favor).

g. PC-513-18; Application to trim or remove 1 Aleppo pine located in the Parklands adjacent to
  2801 Via Segovia

  Applicant:  Jeff Coppersmith
  2801 Via Segovia
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

The applicant’s representative Charles Peterson and the resident of 2808 Paseo Del Mar spoke in
support of this view application. Craig Ellis, the resident of 2920 Via Alvarado spoke in opposition.

Action: Committee member Richie-Bray motioned second by McCabe to recommend to the City
Council approval to trim the Aleppo pine tree to lift the branches off the ground and thin the foliage
to accent the wind swept character and improve the view. The vote was (5-0, in favor).

  Page 3 of 4

  003
 h. Consideration of a new ‘Designated Street Tree’ for Paseo La Cresta west of Via Fernandez, La
Cresta Place, Cloyden Road and Cloyden Square.

Action: Committee member Wade motioned second by Richie-Bray to recommend to the City
Council approval with modification to approve the Strawberry tree for Paseo La Cresta west of Via
Fernandez and La Cresta Place and the Crape Myrtle ‘Tuscarora’ for Cloyden Square. Direct staff to
provide pictures for the next meeting of the 25 feet mark outside Mr. Irv Miller’s viewing area.

NOTIFICATION

Interested parties attending the Parklands Committee meeting were made aware that the above noted
recommendations would be transmitted to the City Council. This item is also noticed in the standard
manner for City Council meetings.

RECOMMENDATION

It is recommended that the City Council review and approve the Parklands Committee
Recommended Actions of July 12, 2018.
